title: Budget amount is deliberately not part of window identity
answers: why does editing budget amount not reset budget spend in redis
changing budget cap should not discard accumulated spend
should budget_amount be stored in the redis budget window
budget limit edit keeps cumulative spend
body:
Invariant: A budget window's identity is its bounds plus the duration that produced them, not budget_amount. An edit that only changes the cap must keep the window and its cumulative_spend, so the new lower/higher limit applies to the existing window.
Enforced in mlflow/gateway/budget_tracker/redis.py:_ENSURE_WINDOW_LUA (compares window_start, duration_unit, duration_value only) and RedisBudgetTracker.should_reject_request via _window_duration_matches (duration fields only).
What breaks if skipped: adding budget_amount to the compared or stored fields rolls the window on every amount-only edit and silently discards accumulated spend, under-counting accounting without making any rejection decision more correct.
Constraints: This applies to amount edits. Duration edits must still roll the window (see the duration-matching rule for this module).
applies: Changes to which fields identify or roll a RedisBudgetTracker window in mlflow/gateway/budget_tracker/redis.py.
says: Editing the gateway budget limit reset all accumulated spend for the current cycle.
Updating a spending cap must preserve previously recorded usage in the active period.
Changing the allowed budget amount wiped out our tracked expenses mid-window.
Lowering the gateway spending threshold should immediately apply against existing expenditures.
Window duration edits should start a new period but amount edits should not.
search: In RedisBudgetTracker window management in mlflow/gateway/budget_tracker/redis.py, budget window identity includes only window bounds and duration fields, deliberately excluding budget_amount so edits to spending limits preserve cumulative_spend. This invariant is enforced in _ENSURE_WINDOW_LUA and RedisBudgetTracker.should_reject_request via _window_duration_matches. Adding budget_amount rolls windows on amount-only edits and discards accumulated spend, whereas duration edits must still roll the window.
